sources.beginner: hand-calc: spreadsheet OLS (SLOPE/INTERCEPT/RSQ) of ln WOR on ln t over the 46 rows the prompt fully specifies, plus closed-form geometry group; taught in beginner m02-m04 and m06/l02-working-the-capstone. Panels (pd-diagnostic-explorer) run teaching well ELELENWO-4 only, no data inputs (panelCapstoneGuard.test.js).
sources.intermediate: hand-calc: same regenerated history, window index floor(n*(1-0.55))=20 (intermediate m01/l03), ratio fit on all late rows and derivative fit on positive-derivative rows (m02/l01), multiplier as ratio of two PSS denominators (m03/l01). pd-channel-explorer offers only teaching-well fraction presets.
sources.advanced: hand-calc: post-choke 4-row fit, derivative fits at 0.30/0.90, GOR 30-row late ratio fit, multiplier at -7.0, all from prompt-specified closed forms; taught in advanced m01-m04. pd-candidate-explorer is teaching-well only.

fields.evidence: OLS of ln WOR on ln t over all 46 generated rows (spreadsheet SLOPE); reproduced 1.09173398797928 vs expected 1.09173398797928.
fields.notes: No reporting precision stated. tol 2e-06 is about 1.8e-06 of the value, so the learner must carry about seven significant figures from a spreadsheet; honest for a full-precision hand-calc. Needs OLS over generated rows (a spreadsheet regression, taught as plain OLS in log space at beginner m02/l01), not a calculator-only step. The Suite Well Intervention Planner (src/components/intervention/DiagnosticPanel.jsx:108) is not named by the prompt, prints the derivative slope to 2 decimals and would not meet tol. No probe number matches any graded answer (checked x1, x100, x0.01).
